findings.detail: The voiceover states 'The BBC confirms that Gabriel's formal notice... has alerted European football's top teams', violating the rule that a report is not confirmation and making an unverified causal claim that the notice alerted top teams.
The motion status is set to 'announced', which is an unverified maturity label as no transfer or move has been announced.
The motion how field states 'Player cancels Manchester United registration', dropping the material qualifier that Gabriel sent notice that he wants to cancel his registration.
The voiceover claims Gabriel 'has triggered intense interest', making an unverified causal claim and overstating the verified 'firm interest'.
